newsitem.title: CHINA: China has stockpiles of shirts, bicycles, watches.
newsitem.headline: China has stockpiles of shirts, bicycles, watches.

text.p: Excessive investment by China's state enterprises in some industries has resulted in a mountain of stockpiled goods ranging from shirts to bicycles to wristwatches, the Guangming Daily said on Thursday.
Warehouses across China have about 150 million unsold men's shirts, the official newspaper said.
There were stockpiles of 20 million bicycles and 10 million wristwatches, it said.
About 70 percent of the 3,000 state enterprises which manufacture cosmetics were suffering a slump in sales, the newspaper said.

China has vowed to curb blind investment by provinces in some industries, but economists say defiance from regional authorities would impede attempts by the central government to restructure the economy.
Concentration of investment in certain industries has led to cutthroat competition resulting in losses, monopolies and local protectionism.
